Don't miss the 'Inside Verity's Closet' Featurette for Verity, an upcoming psychological thriller distributed by Amazon MGM Studios. Take a tour of Verity's closet in Verity, in theaters on October 2.Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford under mysterious circumstances, but her assignment takes a dark turn after discovering chilling autobiographical notes. Faced with a series of deadly family secrets, Lowen struggles to separate fiction from reality, while also blurring the lines with Verity’s husband, Jeremy.

The film stars Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, and Josh Hartnett. Verity is produced by Nick Antosca, Alex Hedlund, Stacey Sher, Michael Showalter, Jordana Mollick, Anne Hathaway, and Colleen Hoover.Verity, directed by Michael Showalter, opens in theaters on October 2, 2026.
